title: The Locker of the quarry
author: Kestrel Marchetti
blurb: Mara Thornbury, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
